limit.description: Max notifications per category to return.

main.description: List notifications for the authenticated user, split by category.

uri.description: at-uri of this notification; the stable key for read/unread state.

type.description: Notification type: repo_starred, issue_created, issue_commented, issue_closed, issue_reopen, issue_assigned, issue_unassigned, pull_created, pull_commented, pull_merged, pull_closed, pull_reopen, pull_assigned, pull_unassigned, followed, user_mentioned.

pullAt.description: AT-URI of the related org.tangled.pulls.pull record, if applicable.

issueAt.description: AT-URI of the related org.tangled.issue.issue record, if applicable.

repoDid.description: DID of the related repository, if applicable.

actorDid.description: DID of the user who triggered this notification.
